The '''2017 Copa Sudamericana finals''' were the two-legged final that decides the winner of the [[2017 Copa Sudamericana]], the 16th edition of the [[Copa Sudamericana]], South America's secondary international club [[association football|football]] tournament organized by [[CONMEBOL]].

The finals were contested in two-legged home-and-away format between [[Argentine Football Association|Argentinian]] team [[Club Atlético Independiente|Independiente]] and [[Brazilian Football Confederation|Brazilian]] team [[Clube de Regatas do Flamengo|Flamengo]]. The first leg was hosted by Independiente at [[Estadio Libertadores de América]] in [[Avellaneda]] on 6 December 2017, while the second leg was hosted by Flamengo at [[Maracanã Stadium|Estádio do Maracanã]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]] on 13 December 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/finales-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-con-horarios-confirmados |title=Finales de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana con horarios confirmados |publisher=CONMEBOL.com |language=Spanish |date=1 December 2017}}</ref>

Independiente defeated Flamengo 3–2 on aggregate to win their second Copa Sudamericana title. As champions, Independiente earned the right to play against the winners of the [[2017 Copa Libertadores]] in the [[2018 Recopa Sudamericana]], and the winners of the [[2017 J.League Cup]] in the [[2018 Suruga Bank Championship]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/conmebol_sudamericana_2017_-_reglamento_28_02_17.pdf |title=Reglamento Conmebol Sudamericana 2017 |publisher=CONMEBOL.com |language=Spanish}}</ref> They also automatically qualified for the [[2018 Copa Libertadores]] group stage.

==Format==
The finals were played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg. If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] would not be used, and 30 minutes of [[extra time (association football)|extra time]] would be played. If still tied after extra time, the [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winner.<ref name="regulations"/> If extra time was played, a fourth substitution would be allowed.

==Matches==
[[Paolo Guerrero]] (Flamengo), provisionally suspended for failing doping test, missed the first leg.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://globoesporte.globo.com/futebol/times/flamengo/noticia/presidente-da-federacao-peruana-diz-que-pena-de-guerrero-tera-extensao-de-20-dias.ghtml |title=Presidente da federação peruana diz que pena de Guerrero terá extensão de 20 dias |publisher=Globo.com |language=Portuguese |date=5 December 2017}}</ref> On 7 December 2017, the FIFA Disciplinary Committee decided to suspend Guerrero for one year, missing the second leg.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/governance/news/y=2017/m=12/news=fifa-disciplinary-committee-sanctions-paolo-guerrero-with-a-one-year-s-2923440.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171208164946/http://www.fifa.com/governance/news/y=2017/m=12/news=fifa-disciplinary-committee-sanctions-paolo-guerrero-with-a-one-year-s-2923440.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=December 8, 2017 |title=FIFA Disciplinary Committee sanctions Paolo Guerrero with a one-year suspension |publisher=FIFA.com |date=8 December 2017}}</ref> After the finals, FIFA Appeal Committee reduced the sanction to a six-month suspension.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/governance/news/y=2017/m=12/news=fifa-appeal-committee-reduces-the-sanction-imposed-on-paolo-guerrero-t-2925556.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171221125746/http://www.fifa.com/governance/news/y=2017/m=12/news=fifa-appeal-committee-reduces-the-sanction-imposed-on-paolo-guerrero-t-2925556.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=December 21, 2017 |title=FIFA Appeal Committee reduces the sanction imposed on Paolo Guerrero to a six-month suspension |publisher=FIFA.com |date=20 December 2017}}</ref>

===First leg===
Flamengo scored after eight minutes when [[Réver]] headed a free kick from Trauco. Independiente equalized through [[Emmanuel Gigliotti]], who combined with Benitez and finished a counter attack. Seven minutes after halftime, Barco crossed from the left side and [[Maximiliano Meza (footballer, born 1992)|Maximiliano Meza]] scored the winning goal with a right-footed volley.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/independiente-vence-flamengo-en-la-primera-pulseada-final |title=Independiente vence a Flamengo en la primera pulseada final |publisher=CONMEBOL.com |language=Spanish |date=6 December 2017}}</ref>

===Second leg===
Lucas Paquetá opened the scoring meters away from the line in the 29th minute after a low cross from Réver. Ten minutes later, Independiente were awarded a penalty for a foul on Meza by Cuéllar. [[Ezequiel Barco]] scored to tie the match.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/independiente-campeon-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2017 |title=Independiente campeón de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2017 |publisher=CONMEBOL.com |language=Spanish |date=13 December 2017}}</ref>
